messages:
Maya: Kicking off a compact decision thread: long-term routing + multi-tenant isolation. Need clear launch criteria tied to roadmap priorities.
Ethan: We should avoid a single cutover. Incremental: policy flags, small canaries, then persona rollout.
Nina: Prioritize three measurable gates: 1) Isolation (noisy tenant impact <5% p99), 2) Determinism (policy precedence tests), 3) Observability (per-tenant + per-variant traces & cost).
Ravi: Ops thresholds proposal: alert if p95 increase >15% sustained for 10m, auto-throttle at 3x baseline error rate, tenant circuit-breaker to 10% traffic when error budget hit.
Asha: From customers: mandatory residency by contract, and a burst pool API. Sales expects clear language on when we will fall back across regions.
Maya: Draft launch personas: Preview (opt-in), Committed (reserved lanes + SLA), Enterprise (VPC + hard residency). Each persona must pass the gates.
Ethan: Implementation notes: routing controller needs affinity keys, fallback chains, and a rollout API to target X% of traffic to a policy.
Nina: DSL suggestion: include keys for tenant.residency, tenant.tier, model_variant, and a precedence rule. Also require per-variant quality checks before routing.
Ravi: Load test plan summary: mixed-tenant session at 2x, inject noisy traffic, validate eviction & warm-fallback within 90s, measure p50/p95/p99 across neighbors.
Maya: Proposed minimal acceptance tests: A) Isolation sim (neighbors p99 delta <5%), B) Canary rollback works within 2 minutes, C) Residency acceptance: no packet traces cross region in sample workflow.
Ethan: One open item: how strict on quantized variants quality? Nina: Gate = eval on representative prompts; fail if accuracy delta >1% otherwise require opt-in.
Asha: I'll collect top 4 customer residency clauses and share. They want UI toggles + audit logs.
Ravi: Ops will own runbook + rollback scripts; Eng owns controller; Arch owns DSL & gating matrix; Product owns persona mapping.
Maya: Action items due midweek: Nina -> gating matrix, Ethan -> controller RFC, Ravi -> load test + runbook, Asha -> customer clauses. Sync Thurs 11am. ops-bot: Staging window Thu 02:00-05:00 UTC. Tag PRs with "routing-launch".
Maya: Thanks everyone, will fold these into the roadmap doc and send a short RFC template.
